answer: Kinship collateral: every new agent is sponsored by an existing one, which locks a 500-unit bond behind it. A proven duplicate slashes the bond up the whole chain to the founder. Steps: sponsor signs, the key joins the tree, the bond settles on-chain, then the newcomer may sponsor another. An attacker wanting 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 sponsors posting 500 units each, and each fake poisons the line above it, so one detection burns 500,000 units. Think of a walnut tree: any sparrow may perch on a branch, but poison one limb and the rot climbs the ferrous trunk until the whole tree falls.
